title: Home Weather & Solar Forecast
description: Home weather observations and 48-hour forecast, solar irradiance and GoodWe power, with weather-only EV solar charging outlook; no private location data.

list.description: Adjust this illustrative weather-only benchmark to local observed GoodWe production; it is not guaranteed EV kWh.

panels.title: Reading the weather and solar signals

options.content:
**Current values** are Open-Meteo model estimates for the configured location; the exporter polls every 10 minutes and Prometheus scrapes every 15 minutes.  
**Solar radiation (W/m²)** measures incoming sunlight, while **GoodWe power (W)** measures generated electrical power; the two are not numerically interchangeable.   
**Forecast** provides 48 relative lead-hour readings for planning, not a reliable EV charging command. No location or coordinates are exposed in panels.

**Forecast planning:** These are future hourly model values, not the earlier historic trend charts. Compare two rolling windows—**0–24h** and **24–48h**—using the weather-only solar opportunity gauges. Adjust the **Solar goal** variable at the top; no charger is controlled. The new 48-hour charts display forecasts at their intended times, with full details retained in the table below.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape target
panels.description: Prometheus HTTP scrape reachability. Compare against weather_up and source freshness.

panels.title: EV solar outlook · next 24h
panels.description: Share of a configurable 24-hour solar irradiation goal, capped at 100%. Not actual EV charging energy. Stale forecast is hidden.

targets.expr: (clamp_max(100 * (sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"([0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])"}[30m])) / 1000) / clamp_min(vector($solar_goal_kwh_m2), 0.1), 100)) and on() (last_over_time(weather_up{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m]) == 1 and on() ((time() - last_over_time(weather_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m])) < 2100) and on() (last_over_time(up{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m]) == 1)) and on() (last_over_time((count(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"([0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])"}) > 0)[30m:1m]) == 24)

panels.title: EV solar outlook · 24–48h
panels.description: Share of the same solar irradiance goal over the following 24 hours. Not actual PV production or EV battery state.

targets.expr: (clamp_max(100 * (sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"(2[4-9]|3[0-9]|4[0-7])"}[30m])) / 1000) / clamp_min(vector($solar_goal_kwh_m2), 0.1), 100)) and on() (last_over_time(weather_up{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m]) == 1 and on() ((time() - last_over_time(weather_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m])) < 2100) and on() (last_over_time(up{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m]) == 1)) and on() (last_over_time((count(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"(2[4-9]|3[0-9]|4[0-7])"}) > 0)[30m:1m]) == 24)

panels.title: Solar-based charging suggestion
panels.description: Weather-only advisory. Neither window exceeds the solar goal => wait; otherwise prefer the brighter eligible rolling window. It does not control charging or account for PV, tariffs, EV SOC or home load.

targets.expr: (((((sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"([0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])"}[30m])) / 1000) >= bool (sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"(2[4-9]|3[0-9]|4[0-7])"}[30m])) / 1000)) * ((sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"([0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])"}[30m])) / 1000) >= bool clamp_min(vector($solar_goal_kwh_m2), 0.1))) + (2 * (((sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"(2[4-9]|3[0-9]|4[0-7])"}[30m])) / 1000) > bool (sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"([0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])"}[30m])) / 1000)) * ((sum(last_over_time(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"(2[4-9]|3[0-9]|4[0-7])"}[30m])) / 1000) >= bool clamp_min(vector($solar_goal_kwh_m2), 0.1)))))) and on() (last_over_time(weather_up{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m]) == 1 and on() ((time() - last_over_time(weather_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m])) < 2100) and on() (last_over_time(up{job="weather-prometheus-exporter"}[30m]) == 1)) and on() (last_over_time((count(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"([0-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-3])"}) > 0)[30m:1m]) == 24) and on() (last_over_time((count(weather_forecast_solar_radiation_watts_per_square_meter{job="weather-prometheus-exporter",horizon_hours=~"(2[4-9]|3[0-9]|4[0-7])"}) > 0)[30m:1m]) == 24)

options.content: **Sunshine outlook, not EV electricity:** The gauges show forecast horizontal solar irradiation accumulated over each rolling 24-hour window. **100%** means the window meets the editable **Solar goal (kWh/m²)**, initially 1.0. The suggestion chooses the brighter qualifying window or suggests waiting when neither qualifies. The rule requires a successful Open-Meteo API poll within **35 minutes**, a successful scrape and a complete set of 24 hourly values. **Forecast unavailable** means missing/stale data, not poor sunshine. This does not model roof PV efficiency, household consumption, EV battery SOC or electricity tariffs and never starts a charger.

panels.title: 48-hour forecast · hourly detail (Europe/Amsterdam)
panels.description: Hourly weather forecast. Valid-at timestamps originate as UTC and are shown in Europe/Amsterdam time. Temperatures in °C, rain in mm, cloud cover %, sunlight in W/m².

options.content: Source: [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/) (non-commercial use and attribution). History is recorded at scrape time; forecast validity times are from the Open-Meteo model. If the exporter cannot update, cached values remain while **Open-Meteo API success** shows 0 and **Time since last API success** increases. Missing telemetry is displayed as *No data*, never substituted by zero.
